decisions.reason: Its 2019 award is a clear positive signal that performance exceeded aspiration levels for a line extension in the firm’s core geothermal offering, so it merits continued support.

Although direct market results are not shown, it fits the established geothermal offer and can be carried with the firm’s scale and slack while management waits for clearer evidence from this product family.

As a complementary surface technology within the same geothermal system, it leverages existing capabilities and is worth retaining under bounded rationality despite still-uncertain standalone results.

This fire-protection profile system is close to the firm’s core building-systems business, so in a growing industry and without clear signs of shortfall it is reasonable to keep it as a satisfcing extension.
The slim steel profile system is also close to existing competences and customer needs, and the lack of negative evidence does not yet justify problemistic search away from it.

Compared with the firm’s more functional and clearly differentiated launches, this decorative surface system shows no positive performance signal by 2021, so it is the likeliest candidate to fall below aspiration and release resources for stronger core projects.
